question_summary: Subcontractor requests approval to substitute PVC piping for the specified cast-iron roof drain leader (Section 22 14 00) prior to ordering material, citing supplier lead times.
proposed_solution: Use a PVC alternate in lieu of cast-iron roof drain leader; submitter states this is cost-neutral and will not affect the domestic water pressure test date.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order
routing_rationale: As a substitution request without an associated cost impact, it defaults to the design professional of record for the Plumbing discipline.
